title: Dates for ukulele, banjo, fiddle and saxophone
summary: The interviewer sorts out the order and dates of his instruments, with sax in 1933 and the Last Round during the Depression.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: I'm getting confused. How old were you when you took up ukulele?
I took ukulele when I was just coming about 22, 23 years old. Then in 1925, that's when I was born in the first band.
In 1925, you were much first band. And then when did you stay to fiddle?
Well, that was when I was going to school. I was about 10, between 10 and 11 years old.
And you started the saxophone that time?
Why were you playing when the Depression hit, when it started?
Last Ronda. I guess you remember that. Yeah, last Ronda.
